response.sql: WITH per_race AS (SELECT r.name AS name, AVG(ds.points) AS avg_points FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON r.raceId = ds.raceId WHERE ds.points > 1.0 GROUP BY r.name), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_points) AS overall_avg FROM per_race WHERE avg_points IS NOT NULL) SELECT p.name AS race_name, p.avg_points AS average_points, p.avg_points - o.overall_avg AS diff_from_overall FROM per_race p JOIN overall o ON 1=1 WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL AND p.avg_points > o.overall_avg
